transcript: I think what was missing for me in this would be discussions of economic equality. chunks.text: I think what was missing for me in this would be discussions of economic equality.
I understand that resources are limited, but I can't imagine a society where money is not important for, you know, housing, medical care, things like that.
So I guess that if I were to add anything, I would add some sort of financial safety net or quality that would allow there to be less of a divide between classes.
